About

Me

An artistic soul with an engineering degree. Teaching models to learn while I figure things out myself, usually with music on and a very concerning amount of coffee.

I'm a 5th-year engineering student in Big Data & Artificial Intelligence at International University of Rabat. My interest in Artificial Intelligence began as a simple curiosity in high school and grew into a real passion, which led me to pursue an Engineering degree in Big Data & Artificial Intelligence. I am now eager to apply this knowledge in a stimulating professional environment, where I can keep learning while contributing to meaningful, real-world projects. Outside of work I love mixing AI with art.
